title: Contact assistance CTA
description: Full-bleed media CTA with title, text, phone/social contacts, primary action, and secondary contact action or modal.

normalization: Normalize telephone to a tel:+7... link when the visible value starts with 8 and has 11 digits.
Treat empty, #, modalContact, and #modalContact secondary links as shared contact modal triggers.
Render social links only when the corresponding variable is non-empty and not #.

runtime: shared modal system handling data-modal-id and data-modal-close
optional header surface handling for data-header-surface

socialIcons.note: Demo icons are block-local. Target projects may map these to their shared social icon assets.

aliases.purpose: Legacy names from existing projects. Agents use these only to find and map old implementations; new code must use the canonical naming fields.

agent.usage: Use this block when the target section is a full-bleed image CTA that helps users choose an option or contact the team, with optional phone/social contacts and one or two actions.
transferSteps: Copy section-contact-assistance-cta.blade.php as the target section view unless the project has an explicit naming map.
Ensure required foundation styles, social-link styles, and the button partial exist before adding block-specific SCSS.
Add a contactAssistanceCta:contactAssistanceCta collection fixture or map an existing legacy key through the target CMS layer.
Map picture to a project-owned media asset; do not keep project-specific asset directory names in new code.
Use section--curved-top and section--curved-bottom for the canonical transition lines; do not add the legacy section--curved-caps modifier.
acceptance: Rendered section has the canonical .contact-assistance-cta class.
Rendered section uses the neutral section--curved-top and section--curved-bottom foundation modifiers for transition lines.
Rendered section uses section--flush and .container.container--full-bleed foundation classes instead of block-specific .container overrides.
Rendered section uses the canonical #contact-assistance-cta id and #contact-assistance-cta-title heading id unless a target project explicitly remaps anchors.
Block-specific SCSS does not target or override .section, .container, .section-header, .section-title, .section-text, .button, or .social-link.
Primary and secondary actions render through the foundation button partial/classes only.
Title, text, picture, action labels, action links, modal id, phone, and socials can be changed through CMS data or variables.
Legacy names appear only in manifest aliases.
notes: This block intentionally excludes curved cap transitions because they are page-level decoration, not the reusable block contract.
